thread:
marta: Quick sync — we need to finalize the incremental rollout + auto-switchover policy for model variants. Current RFC left a few gaps around stateful sessions and probing.

ton y: +1. Can we list the specific gaps? I recall: probe types, decision window, and model affinity across sessions.

marta: Exactly. Also: how the router should surface signals to the control plane (simple enums vs full traces), and whether fallback should re-route whole sessions or individual requests.

kpatel: Important: session affinity. If we switch mid-session and the new model has different tokenization / vocab, client experiences can break. Prefer whole-session pinning unless we can do KV cache migration.

rachel: KV migration is expensive. For LLMs we can do partial warm-up: send a background priming request to new variant to populate its KV cache for that session id, but only for hot sessions. Tradeoffs: extra cost and complexity.

infra-bot: deploybot: staged rollout started for model v3-alpha to 5% in us-west. probes: latency, 4xx/5xx, token-error-rate.

sam: Proposal for probes: 1) blackbox latency/error probe (synthetic traffic), 2) user-facing degradations (p99 latency, 5min error budget burn), 3) semantic regressions (score on golden prompt set). Decision window = 10m for blackbox, 30m for semantic.

marta: Agree with probe tiers. We should treat semantic regressions as first-class — automatic fallback only after both perf and semantic thresholds. Avoid noisy rollbacks.

tony: Router/control-plane interface suggestion: router emits a small signal bundle per interval: {p50,p95,p99,err_rate,semantic_delta}. Control plane evaluates policy rules and returns action: CONTINUE/HOLD/ROLLBACK/REDIRECT. Keep the bundle compact (string enums + floats).

kpatel: For sessions, add affinity hint: SESSION_PINNED:true/false and preferred_variant. That way control plane can decide to pin or switch.

rachel: We should also support a "gradual-degrade" mode: when semantic drift detected but perf fine, route X% of traffic to cheaper fallback variant for monitoring — not full rollback.

sam: Quick config example for policy (proto-ish):
```
policy: {
  decision_window: "10m",
  semantic_threshold: 0.15,
  perf_thresholds: { p99_ms: 1200, error_rate: 0.01 },
  session_affinity: "respect",
  fallback_strategy: "percent_shed_then_swap"
}
```

becca: Love this. Action items: 1) sam draft compact signal schema and proto, 2) tony draft router API (signal + affinity hint), 3) marta + kpatel write session-affinity guideline (KV warm-up vs whole-session pin). I'll open a short RFC PR with these pieces.

marta: Thanks — aiming for PR by EOD tomorrow. @infra-bot please hold further staged rollouts until we have the proto. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploybot: acknowledged, holding additional ramps.
